enemy_1.name: Cloche Clobber
enemy_1.description: A red enamel gardening robot hides under an oversized protective bell lid and pokes intruders with a pruning fork.

enemy_2.name: Rinse Biscuit
enemy_2.description: A tiny blue rinse robot wears a spotless filter bonnet and treats every visitor as a stain.

enemy_3.name: Compost Cougher
enemy_3.description: A leaking green compost robot keeps its corrosive leftovers in a tank that is one sneeze from bursting.

enemy_4.name: Crimp Foreman
enemy_4.description: A heavy clamp robot pinches protective shells open with an oversized pair of press jaws.

enemy_act_1_miniboss_1.name: Hedge Accountant
enemy_act_1_miniboss_1.description: A boxy hedge robot tries to trim every living thing into the same approved rectangle.

enemy_act_1_miniboss_2.name: Snip Etiquette
enemy_act_1_miniboss_2.description: A tall red pruning robot performs fussy little bows between rude mechanical snips.

enemy_act_1_boss_1.name: Mother Pot
enemy_act_1_boss_1.description: A walking nursery boiler releases tiny maintenance robots from its belly and insists they are seedlings.

enemy_minion_1.name: Boltling
enemy_minion_1.description: A red seed-capsule robot charges ahead on feet much too large for its body.

enemy_minion_2.name: Washerling
enemy_minion_2.description: A blue washer-shaped nursery robot fusses over its shell before waddling into trouble.
